notes.title: Deutsch language and fix gameplay
notes.content:
Thanks for translating into Deutsch language this guy [url=https://steamcommunity.com/id/fjoexxl2] -=[ BME ]=- Joey[/url]

Fixed the problem of changing music when changing the focus of the game (alt-tab, windows mode)

Increase the attack speed and teleport from Illidor.
And also the place where Illidore appears, after the attack is pressed, it is displayed with a copy of it.

Small different things that were not visible to anyone, but I repaired them. Therefore, I am boasting)))
